auditSemantics: Single orchestrator; every gate (contract validation, host syntax, source gates, resource budget, unittest suite) is rerun in this process and the fresh report files are consumed. They are structural/local evidence, not target-runtime evidence. Real Core behavior is verified separately by the real Core ucode runtime harness (tools/docker-validate/harness -> core-runtime-harness.log) and the Remote OpenWrt SDK build (exact APK metadata). Rill is an EXTERNAL runtime dependency: this repository never compiles or natively tests Rill; the PM-side fail-closed contract is verified while the upstream external integration is reported as BLOCKED (docs/rill-integration-status.json) — never as PASS.
